app.name: Letter Flip
app.long_description: Letter Flip helps children learn normal and mirrored letters and digits. Practice uses a set card count without losing chances. Challenge uses a chance limit set in Settings. Choose all letters, uppercase, lowercase, or numbers. Jamie's voice reads symbols, menus, settings, help, and gentle feedback. Use a GameCube controller in port 1, or a Wii Remote upright with A/B or sideways with 2/1. Pause, repeat voice, sound, screen flashes, and memory-card save options are available.
